GACC-2026-24.claim: From 2026-04-01, 9610 cross-border ecommerce retail export returns may enter through a different eligible China customs district instead of the original export customs; returned goods must enter an eligible customs-supervised operation site.

GACC-INTERPRETATION-20260318.claim: The official interpretation says enterprises may choose the most convenient eligible return port based on logistics cost and time; pilot volume reached 381,300 return tickets worth RMB 94 million by end-February 2026.

TAX-RETURN-2026-16.claim: For 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31, eligible cross-border ecommerce exports under 1210/9610/9710/9810 returned in original condition within six months may receive import-duty/import-tax relief subject to documentation and other conditions.

CHINAPOST-JINAN-20260723.claim: Shandong Post, local government, customs and AliExpress completed a 272-parcel 9610 cross-customs return flow through Jinan and estimated the model can reduce comprehensive logistics cost by more than 30%.

SHAANXI-FIRST-20260918.claim: Shaanxi reported its first 9610 cross-customs return flow in September 2026 and said the route saved about 50% in capital and time cost for the batch.

SHENZHEN-9610-CENTER.claim: Shenzhen Cross-Border Trade Logistics Supervision Center publicly offers 9610 export/import/return plus 9710/9810 flows, multimodal consolidation, declaration and tracking through a supervised logistics facility.

RTURN.claim: rturn already connects US return-warehouse intake, inspection, Recovery Value, Inventory Disposition and Seller Payout, with seller and partner workflows and MCP/agent access.

SFC-RETURNS-ROUTING.claim: SFC's current 2026 reverse-logistics framework explicitly routes returns among local resale, repair, liquidation, recycling, consolidation back to China and other dispositions based on condition, recovery value and total cost.

CBAM-O3CI.claim: The EU CBAM Registry includes an O3CI module for non-EU installation operators to upload and share installation and emissions data with reporting declarants; accredited verifiers can review supporting evidence and issue verification reports.

CBAM-CHINA-PLATFORM.claim: Carbbit currently markets a CBAM compliance platform for Chinese exporters with China-side supplier data collection/verification and data channels to European consulting agencies.

CBAM-SHANGHAI-TOOL.claim: Shanghai's enterprise-going-global service platform lists a current CBAM TOOL for Chinese manufacturers covering carbon calculation, reporting, dynamic cost warning and traceable data retention.

TOOLING-HANDOVER.claim: Current guidance for overseas buyers exiting a China sourcing service describes transfer of tooling, files, supplier relationships and open claims, and states a receiving sourcing service can practically handle the factory-side handover.

TOOLING-TRANSFER-SERVICE.claim: A current China mold-transfer service packages audit, logistics, trial, re-validation and production restart when buyer-owned tooling moves to another supplier.

REMOTE-CHINA-WAREHOUSE-RETURN.claim: A current China warehouse service lets overseas customers remotely return parcels already stored in China, including domestic courier pickup, activity logs, tracking and photo records.
